title: Form fresh series through the shared trigger path

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-001 RED: no ring buffer/shared trigger acceptance exists; GREEN: advertising maintains a short buffer from the selected downscaled camera, physical ESP32 and clearly labelled test triggers enter one acceptance path with distinct trigger_source, each accepted trigger forms one fresh configured pre/post series, and events during capture/search/success cooldown are ignored; decisive comparison: idle/busy fixtures compare source, frame timestamps/counts, freshness and ignored events; artifact: Playwright transcript and series dumps under .tasks/TASK-050-T2-FT-003-W3/.
purpose: Create the ring-buffer and one trigger-acceptance path that owns series freshness and overlap behavior.
success_outcome: Both trigger sources form the same fresh bounded series and cannot overlap an active attempt lifecycle.
anti_goals: Do not implement sensor transport or camera selection.
Do not implement detection, encoding, request formation, outcome branching or notices.
Do not persist triggers or add person/window deduplication.

forbidden_scope: Camera selection and sensor transport owned by TASK-061 and TASK-046
Detector/crop/submission owned by TASK-047, TASK-048 and TASK-052
Outcome and notice behavior owned by TASK-053 and TASK-067
stop_conditions: Trigger sources require divergent acceptance paths.
Fresh series cannot be proved without durable sensor storage.
Overlap cannot be rejected across accepted active states.

constraints: Use real-browser fake-media fixtures and the protocol-equivalent ESP32 integration.
Physical and test sources differ only in trigger_source metadata.
Use disposable profiles and retain transcript/series dumps.
invariants: One accepted trigger forms one fresh series.
Busy-state triggers are ignored and never queue.
Trigger acceptance creates no intermediate server state.
verification_targets: Overlap fixtures prove no second capture or state disturbance.
